claims.claim_text: Case Number: SC-017
Date of Incident: September 26, 2019
claims.evidence_observations: The title card at 00:13 states 'THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 26, 2019'.

claims.claim_text: Time of Incident: Approximately 0237–0310 hours
claims.evidence_observations: The title card at 00:13 states 'AT 0307 HOURS', which falls within the 0237-0310 hour range.

claims.claim_text: Location: 1250 East La Habra Boulevard, La Habra, CA (Metro Auto Sales / Express Auto Recon)
claims.evidence_observations: The title card at 00:13 states '1250 EAST LA HABRA BOULEVARD LA HABRA'. The video shows a black SUV parked near a gate at this location.

claims.claim_text: Reporting Officer: Officer D. Pritchard
Badge Number: 3894
Subject: Raymond Aguilar, Male, 29 years old, Hispanic, visible tattoos on arms and neck
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a black SUV (Escalade) with a driver, but the subject is not clearly visible as Raymond Aguilar with visible tattoos on arms and neck. The subject is seen in the driver's seat, not passenger seat as claimed in other parts of the report, but the specific details of tattoos are not clearly visible in the low-light footage.

claims.claim_text: Officer(s): Officer D. Pritchard, K9 Officer M. Webb, Officer Trainee L. Garza, Officer S. Rowan, Sergeant V. Huerta, Sergeant P. Daniels
Witness(es): Auto body shop owner (W-1)
On September 26, 2019, at approximately 0237 hours, La Habra Police Department dispatch received an anonymous call reporting multiple subjects dismantling a vehicle near 200 South Alpine Street.
At approximately 0241 hours, Officers Pritchard, K9 Officer Webb, and Officer Trainee Garza indicated they would respond.
I was driving a marked black and white LHPD patrol vehicle.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a marked black and white LHPD patrol vehicle, consistent with the claim that the officer was driving a marked patrol vehicle.

claims.claim_text: K9 Officer Webb and Trainee Garza were in a marked K9 police vehicle.
While traveling eastbound on Alpine Street, I observed a chain-link gate on the south side of the street that appeared to have been forced open.
claims.evidence_observations: The claim states the gate was on the south side of Alpine Street, but the video shows a chain-link gate at what appears to be the rear of a building (Metro Auto Sales), not necessarily on the south side of a street named Alpine Street. The street name is not visible in the video.

claims.claim_text: The gate was at the rear of Metro Auto Sales, located at 1250 East La Habra Boulevard.
claims.evidence_observations: The footage shows a chain-link gate at the rear of a property with a police vehicle nearby, consistent with the location of Metro Auto Sales at 1250 East La Habra Boulevard.

claims.claim_text: I observed a black Cadillac Escalade parked in the driveway past the open gate with its headlights on and the radio playing at low volume.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a black SUV (Escalade) parked in a driveway with headlights on and radio playing at low volume, consistent with the description.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0246 hours, I exited my patrol vehicle and approached the driver's side of the Escalade.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows an officer exiting a patrol vehicle and approaching the driver's side of the Escalade, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: I observed the subject, later identified as Raymond Aguilar, as the sole occupant seated in the driver's seat.
claims.evidence_observations: The claim states the subject was in the driver's seat, but the video shows the subject in the passenger compartment. This directly contradicts the claim.

claims.claim_text: The subject had visible tattoos on his arms and neck.
claims.evidence_observations: The claim states the subject had visible tattoos on his arms and neck. The video is dark and grainy, making it difficult to confirm the presence of tattoos. The subject's arms and neck are not clearly visible in the footage.

claims.claim_text: I gave verbal commands for the subject to exit the vehicle, but the subject refused to comply and made incoherent statements.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject in the driver's seat refusing to comply with commands, and the audio includes incoherent statements, matching the claim.

claims.claim_text: This initial contact was not captured on body-worn camera.
Shortly after, K9 Officer Webb and Trainee Garza arrived and parked their K9 vehicle in the driveway behind the Escalade.
claims.evidence_observations: The footage shows a K9 vehicle parked behind the Escalade, consistent with the claim that K9 Officer Webb and Trainee Garza arrived and parked their vehicle.

claims.claim_text: Officers activated their body-worn cameras at this time.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows officers activating their body-worn cameras, which is consistent with the claim that officers activated their body-worn cameras shortly after the initial contact.

claims.claim_text: Officer Rowan arrived at approximately 0247 hours.
I repositioned the K9 vehicle so that its front bumper was nearly in contact with the rear bumper of the Escalade to prevent it from reversing.
claims.evidence_observations: The footage shows a police vehicle positioned close to the rear of the Escalade, consistent with the claim that the K9 vehicle was repositioned to prevent reversing.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0248 hours, the subject started the Escalade's engine and the headlights brightened.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject starting the Escalade's engine and the headlights brightening, which is consistent with the claim that the subject started the engine and headlights brightened at approximately 0248 hours.

claims.claim_text: The subject rolled down the driver's side window and extended both hands outside the vehicle momentarily.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is seen extending both hands outside the vehicle momentarily, matching the claim.

claims.claim_text: K9 Officer Webb took a position near the driver's side door of the K9 vehicle and began issuing commands and K9 announcements through the PA speaker, instructing the subject to exit from the driver's side with his hands up.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a K9 officer near the driver's side door of the K9 vehicle and issuing commands, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: The subject refused all commands and began revving the engine, honking the horn, and flashing gang signs from the driver's side window.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is seen in the driver's seat, but the claim states he began revving the engine, honking the horn, and flashing gang signs from the driver's side window; while the video shows the subject in the driver's seat, the specific actions of revving, honking, and flashing gang signs are not clearly visible or audible in this clip.

claims.claim_text: He yelled profanities at officers in English.
claims.evidence_observations: The audio includes yelling profanities at officers, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: Due to distance and noise, it was difficult to understand the subject at times.
claims.evidence_observations: The audio includes difficulty understanding the subject due to distance and noise, matching the claim.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0257 hours, the rear hatch of the Escalade opened and Sergeant Daniels heard the subject reference the word "shoot."
claims.evidence_observations: The rear hatch of the Escalade is seen opening, and the audio includes a reference to the word 'shoot,' matching the claim.

claims.claim_text: Multiple officers observed the subject gesture as if simulating a firearm.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is seen gesturing with his hands as if simulating a firearm, matching the claim.

claims.claim_text: Officers decided to deploy oleoresin capsicum rounds.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows officers preparing to deploy OC rounds, consistent with the decision to deploy oleoresin capsicum rounds.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0301 hours, Sergeant Daniels deployed a 40mm OC round through the open rear hatch.
claims.evidence_observations: At approximately second 730, a 40mm OC round is deployed through the open rear hatch, matching the claim.

claims.claim_text: The subject was unaffected and continued yelling.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject continues to yell after the OC round deployment, matching the claim that he was unaffected.

claims.claim_text: Sergeant Daniels deployed a second OC round with no effect.
claims.evidence_observations: A second OC round is deployed through the open rear hatch, matching the claim.

claims.claim_text: The subject then placed the Escalade in reverse and began backing toward officers and the K9 vehicle.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject places the Escalade in reverse and begins backing toward officers and the K9 vehicle, matching the claim.

claims.claim_text: Officers were forced to move out of the way.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject shifts to drive and accelerates forward through the open gate, colliding with vehicles, matching the claim.

claims.claim_text: The subject shifted to drive and accelerated forward through the open gate, colliding with several vehicles parked inside the auto body shop.
claims.evidence_observations: The Escalade is seen driving into the interior garage bay and pushing a white Mercedes through a second rollup door, matching the claim.

claims.claim_text: The subject rammed a metal rollup garage door, drove into the interior garage bay, then used the Escalade to push a white Mercedes through a second rollup door on the opposite side of the building.

claims.claim_text: As the Escalade began to accelerate forward, I observed the subject raise his left arm toward the driver's side window in what appeared to be a shooting position.
claims.evidence_observations: The claim states the subject raised his left arm toward the driver's side window in a shooting position, but the video shows the subject in the driver's seat, making it unclear if he raised his arm toward the driver's side window or if the description is inaccurate.

claims.claim_text: Believing the subject was about to fire at Sergeant Huerta, who was in the subject's direct line of travel, I discharged my Colt AR-15A4 patrol rifle seven rounds in approximately two seconds as I advanced toward the Escalade.
